Design the **error** state of the Notifications screen for **mifos-x-open-banking**, a Open Banking KMP super-app - consumer retail banking + field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7, built with Compose Multiplatform across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web Material 3 balanced dark theme, 393×852dp (Pixel 5), Outfit font throughout.
